description: This file is a Python script configuring and running a conversational AI bot that integrates speech-to-text, text-to-speech, video generation, and various AI services within a pipeline. It defines transport parameters, sets up service clients, constructs a processing pipeline, and handles client connection events.

classes.description: Holds the conversation context for the language model interactions.

classes.description: Pairs user and assistant aggregators with a shared conversation context.

classes.description: Configuration parameters for user response aggregation.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Defines the sequence of processing steps for the AI pipeline.
